text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Importers say sharp practices continue at ports despite government sanitisation reforms.
- Currency trafficking no longer a threat to Nigeria's economy with introduction of the weekly autonomous foreign exchange market (AFEM), Central Bank's governor says.
- Petrochemicals industry in southeastern Eleme shut down due to huge debts.
- Electoral commission postpones compilation of voters register for municipal elections on party basis to November from September.
- Government plans increase in university students' tuition fees.
